o1.say: Mastercard powers economies and empowers people through our global operating system.

o2.say: Let me show you how we do that.

l1.say: Everything Mastercard runs fits into five layers, stacked into one system.

l2.say: At the base, the kernel: the network itself.

l3.say: Then the rails that move money.

l4.say: The network services every rail can call.

l6.say: And access, where partners plug in.

l7.say: Around it, everyone the system serves.

a1.say: Take a bank. Its goal: cut fraud, without declining good customers.

a2.say: Choose that, and the parts of the system that deliver it light up, in the order they act.

a3.say: Recorded Future spots stolen cards and skimmers early.

a4.say: Threat Intelligence turns those threats into fraud signals.

a5.say: em-dess swaps card numbers for tokens.

a6.say: Identity Check steps in only when the risk warrants it.

a7.say: And Decision Intelligence Pro scores every transaction in flight, fed by data from the whole network.

a8.say: Open any of them for the detail.

a9.say: Decision Intelligence Pro uses generative AI to score transactions from any network, at the moment of authorization.

a10.say: It can lift the detection of compromised cards by up to three hundred percent.

b1.say: Now take a government, with payments to get to people, quickly and safely.

b2.say: In the UK, Backs carries about ninety-eight percent of state benefits.

b3.say: Mastercard Move disburses to cards, accounts and wallets, and Send pushes funds to a card in seconds.

b4.say: Where people have no bank, Community Pass gives them a digital identity.

b5.say: Account to Account Protect screens each payment for scams.

b6.say: And Spending Pulse tracks how spending moves afterwards.

b8.say: It is shared digital identity and payments infrastructure, for rural and underserved communities.

b9.say: Through the Made Alliance, it aims to reach one hundred million people and businesses in Africa, by twenty thirty-four.

c1.say: One system. Five layers. Working together for banks, businesses, governments and people.

c2.say: This is the Mastercard Operating System.
